integrity: The continuum theorem is proved analytically by an exact Helstrom upper certificate and a closed-form nonnegative success-profile factorization. The packaged numerical replay is corroborative and is not used as a substitute for the continuum proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the source benchmark with three copies, \(\alpha=\pi/4\), \(\theta_{\max}=\pi/3\), and equal label priors; no general formula for other copy numbers, angles, nuisance ranges, qutrit models, or locality-constrained measurements is claimed.
title: Exact continuous minimax value for the three-copy robust qubit benchmark
